plain: A claim that someone did something wrong, made before it has been proved.

more.text: That which is affirmed or asserted; that which is offered as a plea, excuse or justification.
In ecclesiastical courts, a formal complaint, or declaration of charges.

example.quote: This is a very extraordinary allegation.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. IREDELL, July 31, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
